blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — GCash parent company Mynt officially debuted on the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) today, October 20, following the largest initial public offering (IPO) in Philippine history. The offering raised approximately ₱60.9 billion, with shares priced at ₱6.60 each. But beyond the record-breaking IPO and the opportunity to invest in GCash’s parent company, what does this milestone mean for ordinary Filipinos who use the app to pay bills, send money, and manage their everyday finances?
